questionEn: What is characteristic specifically of “Oxide”, and not of a related concept?
questionUz: Tegishli tushunchaga emas, balki "Oksid" ga nima xosdir?
choicesEn: Oxides are divided into several groups depending on their reaction with water, bases and acids: Basic.
A complex substance of two elements, one of which is oxygen
choicesUz: Oksidlar suv, asoslar va kislotalar bilan reaksiyasiga qarab bir necha guruhga bo'linadi: Asosiy.
Ikki elementdan iborat murakkab modda, ulardan biri kislorod
explanationEn: Oxides are divided into several groups depending on their reaction with water, bases and acids: Basic oxides: Na2O, BaO, CuO, etc.
explanationUz: Oksidlar suv, asoslar va kislotalar bilan reaksiyaga kirishishiga qarab bir necha guruhga bo'linadi: Asosiy oksidlar: Na2O, BaO, CuO va boshqalar.
